title: Maltopia
body:
Welcome to the official Modrinth page for the Maltopia!

This modpack is not required to play on the server, but it is highly recommended for the best possible Maltopia experience.

The pack includes Simple Voice Chat, several performance and optimization mods, and a handful of quality-of-life enhancements designed to make gameplay smoother, more immersive, and more fun—without changing the vanilla feel of the server.

If you want clearer communication, better performance, and that extra layer of immersion while playing on Maltopia, this modpack has you covered.
